create_deprecate_function: create a decorator that emits a deprecation warning and redirects to an alternative function
refactor_deprecate_kwarg: refactor a function to deprecate a keyword argument and map old values to new values
test_deprecate_nonkeyword_arguments: test a decorator that enforces all arguments after allowed ones must be passed as keyword arguments
review_Substitution_docstring: review the docstring substitution decorator that performs string replacement on function docstrings
build_Appender_docstring: build a decorator that appends a custom addendum to a function's docstring
